basics.heading: Why a primary care doctor matters
paras: A primary care physician diagnoses and treats a wide range of conditions and is your first point of contact. You have one person to call and one place to go, which often means avoiding the cost and wait of an emergency room.

Prevention is the focus. Regular checkups catch problems like high blood pressure and high cholesterol early, while they are easier to manage. When you do need a specialist or community services, Dr. Khan coordinates it and stays your advocate.
Many health plans also require you to name a primary care physician. Dr. Khan accepts most PPO plans and Medicare, and offers an optional concierge membership for direct access.

faq: Yes. Dr. Khan accepts Aetna, Anthem, Cigna, Humana and Blue Cross Blue Shield PPO plans, plus Tricare and Medicare. He does not accept Medi-Cal, CalOptima or HMO plans. See insurance details.
Do I need to join the concierge membership?
No. Membership is optional. It adds direct access to Dr. Khan, an annual physical with labs, a yearly home visit and other benefits. See membership.
Can I get labs done at the office?
Yes. Blood is drawn in the office and sent out for testing.
The practice cares for patients of all ages. Call the office to confirm availability for your child's visit.
